text: Its peers are pulling back from microfinance. Equitas is walking in.
Clue one. Ujjivan's group loans? Down to thirty four percent of its book. E S A F's micro loans? They shrank this quarter.
Clue two. Equitas's microfinance and micro loans? Up seventy percent in a year, even after removing loans it bought.
The twist. The fuel is costly. Cheap CASA deposits fell one percent, while total deposits rose nineteen.
Brave contrarian, or early to a recovery? Back to the napkin.
